title: Disappointed
text: I am a huge Yoda fan and was truly excited for the Dagobah box for February, where you would and should expect Yoda to be prominent. The reveal was very disappointing. I am tired of the huge Funko instead of really cool smaller figurines. 4 items for $30?  Sticker, mini, notepad and movie scene. Not what I was hoping for and what we used to get. Will not be purchasing the April box. Funko and Amazon really are letting the collectors down.
label: negative
